items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He said, “How you doing, J.B.?” I said, “Great.” ... “George Bernard,” he said.

ctx.x: I knew he wanted me to ask, who was J.B? So I said, “I’ll see you tonight.” And so we left. Came to work that evening for the show. He said, “How you doing, J.B.?” I said, “Great.” Benny had this kind of smirky smile. He’d look at you. J.B., J.B., for about two weeks. Finally, I said, “All right. Who’s J.B.?” “George Bernard,” he said. [laughter] I kid you not. He was too much.
